surgery.

8. Marking and Packing 

8.1 The trstrunients shall be legibly and indelibly marked with the manufacturer's name, initials or 
reccgnized trade-mark, the words 'Stainless Steel or the 'SS', and the country of manufacture. 

8.2 Each Inbtrumcrt shall first be wrapped In a suitable cushioning material like tissue paper and 
then put in a polyethyler.e bag or wrapped in wax paper. The instruments shall thereafter be packed 
in cartons In accordance with the cunent trade practice. 

8.2.1 Alternatively, the instruments may be packed as agreed to between the purchaser and the 
supplier. 

8.3 The packages shalt be marked with the name of the instrument; the manufacturer's name, initials 
or recognized trade-mark; the words 'Stainless Steel'; and the country of manufacture. 

8.4 Certificatiof} Marking — Details available with the Bureau of Indian Standards.

EXPLANATORY NOTE 

This standard was first issued in 1974. In this revision, tolerances on various dimensions have 
been specified, a recommended sampling plan has been added and the clauses on surface condition 
have been modified besides incorporating certain other modifications.
